title: dashboard page header: Refresh All stays in the dashboard renderer's own row instead of the page header's actions, because moving it would stop the auto-refresh timer
body:
Derived in-flight sub-issue of #12526. It carries the part of that card's item 1 that its PR objectui#12552 measured it could not do without a new prop: a dashboard's Refresh All among the page header's actions. It inherits `domain:ui` and `priority:p2` from #12526, by the dispatching seat (`domain:ui` seat 1, session `session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB`).

Parent: #12526. This card is dispatchable once PR objectui#12552 merges.

Blocked-by: #12526 (its PR objectui#12552 must merge first)

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:ui` lane's next dispatch, in `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` (`DashboardRenderer`) and `@object-ui/app-shell` (`DashboardView`), size S–M.

## What happens

After #12552, a dashboard's page header draws the icon, the title and the description in one row. "Refresh All" is still drawn by `DashboardRenderer`, in the renderer's own row below the page header. The audit's reference design puts a page's actions at the right of its one header row.

## Readings (the #12526 dev report, mechanism assumption A2)

- `DashboardRenderer` draws its refresh control whenever it holds `onRefresh`.
- The same handler arms `useDashboardAutoRefresh`'s timer for an authored `refreshIntervalSeconds` (objectui#11062).
- So dropping `onRefresh` to move the button would stop the timer.
- `hideHeaderText` (`DashboardRenderer.tsx:285`) hides only the renderer's title and description.

## What to build

1. The renderer can be told not to draw its own refresh control while it keeps the auto-refresh timer armed. For example, a host flag next to `hideHeaderText`.
   - This is a new prop on a published renderer, so the claim declares `Clause-②: yes`.
   - Its name and shape are the dev's, measured against the renderer's existing host flags.
2. `DashboardView` draws Refresh All, with its existing pack keys (`dashboard.refreshAll` / `refreshDashboard` / `refreshing`) and its spinning state, among the page header's actions.
3. Edit Layout and the design-mode buttons, if the console draws them, follow the same rule or stay. That is the dev's measurement, stated in the report.

## Acceptance

- Tests: the dashboard page header carries Refresh All. The renderer draws no second one. An authored `refreshIntervalSeconds` still re-reads on its timer (the objectui#11062 pin, unchanged).
- A browser reading by the landing seat at 1440 on HotCRM's Sales Performance dashboard: one header row with Refresh All at the right, and no refresh button below it.
- One changeset for `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` and `@object-ui/app-shell`, minor.

Attribution: filed by the `domain:ui` seat 1 in session `session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB` (account `sunhaolin`), from the #12526 dev report.
